customManagers.description: Track the django-notifications commit pinned in pyproject.toml. The standard pep621 manager ignores `git+https` direct references, which would otherwise leave this dependency invisible to Renovate. Deliberately scoped to django-notifications only: django-tagulous is pinned to a commit on a fork branch that carries a Django 5.2 fix absent from that fork's default branch, so bumping it to the branch head would silently regress it.
